role: independent nonbuilder final changed-candidate reviewer A
method: Read, hash, diff and byte comparisons only. No execution, syntax check, probe, lock, signal, installation or candidate edit. No current peer output read. Unchanged primitive identity/applicability checked, not re-audited.

narrow_prior_disposition.use: Prior-round scope and qualifications, not a substitute for independent source judgment.
